rows.ARS:
Orange or orange-red Hybrid Tea.
Exhibition name: Cordwalles Centenary Rose
rows.Origin:
Bred by Ludwig Taschner (South Africa, before 2012).
Introduced in South Africa by Ludwig's Roses in before 2012 as 'Cordwalles Centenary Rose'.
rows.Bloom: Orange - vermilion, ages to light brown . Mild fragrance. Double (17-25 petals), borne mostly solitary, high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.

colour: Orange - vermilion, ages to light brown .
